capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 113 kWh total (Wikipedia, EVspecs.org); EV Specifications shows 105/100 kWh gross/usable, conflicting.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 400 V pack (EV Specifications, all 2023 Ocean variants).

dc_max_kw.notes: 250 kW (EVspecs.org and EV Specifications port table; its charge-time table uses 200 kW). Wikipedia lists 175 kW for all trims (conflict). EV Specifications Extreme page also lists 100/105 kWh usable/gross (vs 106.5/113) and a 200 kW charge-time table.

ac_max_kw.notes: 11 kW on-board charger (EVspecs.org, EV Specifications for the J1772 port); Wikipedia lists 7.4 kW (conflict). No North American-specific figure found; the 11 kW is for the J1772 port per EV Specifications.
